summary: Exact reserve model and local proofs completed; the infinite bound for the 81-bit seed remains open.
mechanism: The uniform 51-cell bulk roundtrip is formally proved for every n>=0, with arbitrary exterior tapes. A separate counted composition gives exactly 906n+2881 transitions.
The exact normal form N(k,w)=A>0(011)^k w accounts for every terminating virtual-core case, including zero-reserve halts and safe F escapes. It reproduces all 792 saved primitive records.

At step 5104 the observed orbit reaches reserve 1 and an explicit 81-bit residual word. Its next 380 observed pairs all satisfy the common-domain reserve bound; no infinite bound has been proved. Uniform constructed families with arbitrarily long common prefixes have opposite halting outcomes. Fixed-prefix tests and the specified small additive potentials cannot establish the needed global safety invariant.
